name: Suppress Fatigue
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level alchemist 1, bloodlord 1, cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, inquisitor 1, shaman 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a pinch of smelling salts)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one creature

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistances yes (harmless)

For the duration, the fatigue condition is suppressed on the target. This does not affect or lower the exhausted condition. At the end of the duration, the creature is fatigued again, unless the underlying condition is removed or ended.
